summary: The exact candidate reproduces the base failure and fixes the tested single connection-pool-group lifecycle, including receiver refresh and a same-key re-registration race. It does not fully clean up a receiver whose bootstrap_infos concatenate multiple connection_pool groups (as CommonKVReceiver._setup_bootstrap_infos does across target CP ranks): failure cleanup snapshots each group separately, so no token matches the concatenated subscriber key and later watermark broadcasts still target the stale receiver.

Independent adversarial lifecycle case: two cached CP groups form one concatenated receiver subscriber. After failure, multi_cp_remaining=1 and stale_broadcast_calls=1; the single-group control has single_cp_remaining=0.
Both changed classes imported from /job/repo/python/sglang/srt/disaggregation/common/{conn.py,staging_handler.py} at the exact candidate checkout, not from an installed wheel.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950 family) was visible through Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, but the defect and candidate change are Python control-plane lifecycle logic and all review tests were CPU-only. No GPU kernel or model execution was claimed.

remaining_counterexamples: When one receiver.bootstrap_infos is the concatenation of two or more connection_pool groups (for example target_cp_ranks=[0,1]), snapshot_wm_subscribers receives each group separately. Neither per-group key equals the concatenated subscriber key, so _handle_node_failure removes no subscriber and _free_and_send_watermark continues sending to the failed node.
remaining_limitations: The reported heterogeneous-TP deployment requires at least three GPUs (two prefill TP ranks plus one decode rank); only one AMD Instinct MI350X was assigned, so no full serving or distributed failure reproduction was possible.
No model weights were needed or used; deterministic tests cover the actual shared NIXL/Mooncake Python staging control-plane implementation, not model semantics.
No native source changed in the candidate, repository-environment.json specifies native=null, and therefore no native rebuild was applicable.
